headlines.title: Wells Fargo Cuts Netflix (NFLX) to Underweight as its 2026 Slide Deepens
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo downgraded Netflix, Inc. (NASDAQ:NFLX) to Underweight from Equal Weight on September 18 and cut its price target to $57 from $80, about 24% below where the stock closed the day before.

headlines.title: Ackman Bets $1 Billion on Netflix Redemption After $400 Million 2022 Loss
headlines.summary: Bill Ackman lost $400 million the last time he bought Netflix and bailed within three months. Now Pershing Square just disclosed a $1 billion position, and the reasons he walked away in 2022 look nothing like the streaming landscape he is walking back into.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
